Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price target boosted by Piper Jaffray Companies to $250.00. They currently have an overweight rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:

Palo Alto Networks (NYSE:PANW) had its price target raised by Jefferies Financial Group Inc to $267.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Palo Alto Networks (NYSE:PANW) had its target price increased by JMP Securities to $270.00. JMP Securities currently has an outperform rating on the stock.
Palo Alto Networks (NYSE:PANW) had its target price raised by Piper Jaffray Companies to $250.00. The firm currently has an overweight rating on the stock.
